title: CertificationMarkRequestedPayload
description: Payload of the CertificationMarkRequested event (class: platform, INV-REQ-1226). The schema is owned by service-runtime. The event is an internal request of tenancy-svc to mark every certified entity of every tenant stale; it is written under the platform tenant with the platform entity. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.
